# Client Reimbursement Policy 2026

The currently effective firm-wide reimbursement policy. Taxi expenses over
100 RMB require manager approval. It supersedes
[[policy-reimbursement-2024]]. VAT treatment for affected taxpayers is
described in [[concept-small-scale-taxpayer-vat]].
